name: moviestar
description: Plan, execute, and verify deterministic video edits with the MovieStar CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the open-source MovieStar CLI to inspect footage, author non-destructive edits, compose scenes, add captions and audio, and verify final renders. Requires a shell-capable environment with Python 3.10 or newer, FFmpeg, and ffprobe. The skill guides installation of the MovieStar package from PyPI.
defaultPrompt: Use MovieStar to edit this video into a concise clip and verify the export.
Use MovieStar to turn this recording into a captioned vertical short.
Use MovieStar to compose these camera angles into a polished scene edit.
